access_links.label: Industrial demand on the openmod wiki

description: Chemicals is a data resource listed in openmod Initiative wiki, a community wiki of open energy models and data under the section "Industrial demand > Chemicals", published or maintained by pubs.acs.org (publisher inferred from the link). Besides energy-related and process-related emissions, this sector includes carbon-embedded in plastic that will be released if they are incinerated at the end of their lifetime. Currently, plastic-embedded CO2 emissions are similar to the sum of energy-related and process-related emissions (see Circular Economy) Carbon-based products (naphtha, liquid petroleum gas, methane) are used as feedstocks. Coverage: as stated on the linked page. The openmod wiki page "Industrial demand" lists it under "Chemicals". It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the wiki page (source page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support industrial demand inputs to energy-system models. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-openmod-initiative-wiki.
licence: not stated on the wiki page (source page not read)
